name: Sheet-Pan Shrimp Fajitas with Black Beans and Tortillas

components.name: Shrimp Fajitas
steps: Set oven to 220 C and spread pepper and onion strips on two hot trays; toss with oil and fajita spices. Roast for about 12-15 minutes.
Pat shrimp dry, mix with lime and a small portion of seasoning, and spread over peppers once they are partly softened.
Return to oven for 6-10 minutes, checking the centre of the largest shrimp reaches 63 C and avoiding overcooking.
Divide fajitas and beans into five meals, keeping tortillas and yogurt separate. Reheat shrimp and vegetables before assembling.

components.name: Black Beans, Tortillas & Yogurt

ingredients.name: Five wheat tortillas 70g each, as purchased

steps: Warm drained cooked beans with tomato in a small saucepan or microwave, and set yogurt aside as a chilled topping.

Refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers at 4°C or colder, for 3–4 days at most, and follow the shorter seafood limit above. Cook fish and shellfish to 63°C and reheat leftovers to at least 74°C.
